accueil.avis.1: “The garden is beautiful in every season, and the big glass doors mean you can enjoy it even when it rains. We’ll be back.”
accueil.avis.2: “A quiet street that leads only to the riverbank, and yet the town centre on foot. We didn’t get back in the car all week.”
accueil.avis.3: “An exceptional welcome from Claire, and excellent advice on exploring the region. Everything is tastefully decorated, spotlessly clean, with good beds.”
accueil.avis.intro: 23 reviews on Google, 62 on Airbnb, and a 100% response rate.
accueil.avis.note: Extracts translated and shortened from reviews published on Google and on Airbnb.
accueil.cta.p: For availability and prices, give your dates and the number of guests: the reply comes quickly.
accueil.desc: Three-star gîte in Charleville-Mézières, for 2 to 5 guests + 1 baby. A 500 m² enclosed garden with a terrace and a barbecue, steps from the greenway and the Meuse, a 10-minute walk from Place Ducale. Book direct, no commission.
accueil.hero.lead: A three-star gîte, fully renovated, for 2 to 5 guests + 1 baby. A 10-minute walk from Place Ducale, steps from the greenway. The gîte is a member of the Club Ardenne Écotourisme.
accueil.hero.titre: A house opening onto a large garden, a short walk from the Meuse
accueil.hote.p1: I work in tourism, and my guests get the benefit of it: I can point you to bike rides, walks, museums, monuments, good restaurants and country markets, in the town and across the Ardennes.
accueil.hote.p2: I’ve been welcoming guests for 9 years and I answer every enquiry quickly.
accueil.hote.p3: Self check-in, using a secure key box, between 5 pm and 8 pm. Check-out is before 11 am.
accueil.jardin.cap3: The squirrel is at home here
accueil.jardin.intro: A wooded, flower-filled garden, fully enclosed, with a terrace on the same level as the living room. Somewhere to have breakfast outside, let the children run about, or do nothing at all.
accueil.lieu.p1: No through traffic: rue Saint-Aubin serves only the houses on it, and ends in the path down to the Meuse and the greenway. That quiet is one of the things guests mention most.
accueil.lieu.p2: The neighbourhood feels like a village, with its little shops and its bus stop. And the centre of Charleville — Place Ducale, its cafés, its cinema — is a 10-minute walk away.
accueil.lieu.p3: From the garden gate you join 130 km of traffic-free cycle path along the Meuse, upstream towards Sedan and Mouzon, downstream to Givet.
accueil.lieu.titre: A street that leads to the riverbank
accueil.maison.cap4: The house, seen from the garden
accueil.maison.intro: A detached house from the 1920s, fully renovated: 70 m², two bedrooms, a bathroom and a fitted kitchen. The living room opens straight onto the terrace through large glass doors.
accueil.maison.savoir.p: the stairs are narrow, and the bathroom is reached through the first-floor bedroom.

contact.titre: Contact and getting here — Gîte Saint-Aubin, Charleville-Mézières
contact.venir.p1: By train: Charleville-Mézières station is 5 minutes away by car, and the number 7 bus stops just along the road. Paris is under 2 hours away.
contact.venir.p2: By bike: the Trans-Ardennes greenway runs alongside the property. A bike shelter is provided.
contact.venir.p3: By car: free parking alongside the property, in a street with no through traffic. The Belgian border is 30 minutes away.
contact.venir.titre: By train, by bike, or by car
eco.desc: The gîte takes part in the Interreg “Ardenne Écotourisme” programme: shower timer, water jug, zero-waste containers, recycling and compost. A renovation carried out with local craftspeople and low-carbon materials.
eco.g1.p: 5 minutes, the length of a shower. Turn it over as you step in, and see whether you can keep to it.
eco.g3.p: “Just water! 100% Ardenne, 0% waste” — here, tap water is drunk from a glass.
eco.g4.p: Reusable containers for a picnic on the greenway. Containers for sorting and compost are provided.
eco.g5.p: Turn the heating off before airing the room: it’s on the sticker, next to the thermostat.
eco.gestes.intro: The programme’s kit is in three languages — French, English and Dutch. Each sticker is placed in the room it refers to: bathroom, kitchen, living rooms.
eco.hero.lead: The gîte takes part in the European Interreg programme “Ardenne Écotourisme”. In practice, a few stickers around the rooms are reminders of simple things you can do for nature. Take them as a little challenge for the length of your stay.
eco.label.p1: It’s an Interreg programme, run on both sides of the border with Accueil Champêtre en Wallonie, Ardennes de France and the RND Pierre + Bois network. It gives accommodation owners a signage kit and a shared framework.
eco.label.p2: The gîte is also listed in the ecotourism section of VisitArdenne.
eco.label.p3: The kit is published in French, English and Dutch — like a good share of the guests, who come from Belgium and the Netherlands.
eco.m1.p: The house was renovated by firms from the Ardennes, using natural or low-carbon materials.
eco.m2.p: Heating comes from a heat pump, with underfloor heating on the ground floor.
eco.m3.p: Careful water use, a shower timer and tap water served at the table.
eco.m6.p: The gîte is a member of the organic grocery La Marcasserie, and the local farmers’ markets are worth asking about.
eco.maison.intro: The renovation was carried out with craftspeople from the region and low-carbon materials. These are choices you can’t see, and they matter far more than the shower timer.
eco.maison.titre: What was done before you arrived
jardin.a1.p: The greenway lets you ride 130 km car-free along the Meuse, upstream towards Sedan and Mouzon, downstream to Givet, where the route joins the Belgian cycle network. It’s also La Meuse à Vélo, EuroVelo 19, which reaches the North Sea 1,000 km further on.
jardin.a2.p: The twin of Paris’s Place des Vosges, built in the early seventeenth century by Clément Métezeau. Shops, restaurants, a cinema, the market and the Maison du Tourisme.
jardin.a3.p: Housed in the Vieux Moulin on the bank of the Meuse, the museum is devoted to Arthur Rimbaud, born in Charleville in 1854. The house he lived in is on the same quay.
jardin.a4.p: Swimming pool and spa, a small marina, a park, sports pitches, a skatepark and a campsite, at the foot of Mont-Olympe. Bike hire is available next to the campsite.
jardin.a4.t: The water sports centre and Mont-Olympe
jardin.a5.p: Down the valley: Monthermé, the Dames de Meuse, the Rocher de l’Ermitage and Belgium half an hour away by car.
jardin.a6.p: A village feel, with all the town’s shops and services on foot or by bike: restaurants, a cinema, a bowling alley. The number 7 bus to the station stops nearby.
jardin.autour.intro: The street leads to the riverbank. Step out of the garden and you are on the greenway: 130 km of cycle path along the Meuse, without ever meeting a car.
jardin.autour.liens: To plan your stay: Ardennes tourist board (ADT), Charleville-Mézières tourist office and Ardenne Écotourisme.
jardin.autour.titre: Everything within walking or cycling distance
jardin.cap.bateaux: Barges and boats on the Meuse
jardin.cap.port: The marina, a short ride away
jardin.desc: 500 m² of enclosed, wooded garden with a terrace on the same level and a barbecue, steps from the greenway and the Meuse. Place Ducale a 10-minute walk away, the Rimbaud museum, the Mont-Olympe water sports centre.
jardin.hero.lead: It’s what guests talk about most. 500 m² of trees and flowers, fully enclosed, leading straight on from the living room.
jardin.hero.titre: A big enclosed garden, opening off the living room
jardin.hotes.intro: A red squirrel regularly crosses the terrace, and the trees are home to birds. The garden also gives redcurrants, wild strawberries and raspberries: Claire picks them, but there is always some left for others.
jardin.hotes.titre: The squirrel is at home here
jardin.j.cap2: Hardy geraniums and the stone wall at the bottom of the garden
jardin.j.cap3: The garden seen from the far end of the plot
jardin.j.p1: A stone wall, a hedge and tall trees all around. Climbing roses, day lilies, borage, redcurrants, wild strawberries, raspberries: it flowers from spring to autumn.
jardin.j.p2: The terrace leads straight off the living room: garden furniture, a barbecue (except during heatwaves), enough room for everyone.
jardin.j.p3: The garden is completely enclosed: children can play out there without being watched every minute.
jardin.saisons.intro: In autumn the path disappears under leaves, in winter the garden goes under snow — and the big glass doors mean you can enjoy it without going out, which comes up often in the reviews.
jardin.saisons.v1: The living room opening onto the garden
jardin.titre: The garden and surroundings — Gîte Saint-Aubin, Charleville-Mézières
maison.chambres.cap3: Second floor: two beds in place, a third on request
maison.cuisine.p1: Induction hob, oven, microwave, dishwasher, fridge, insulated filter coffee maker, kettle, toaster.
maison.cuisine.p2: In the drawer: table cutlery, kitchen knives, a bread knife, spatulas, a ladle, a skimmer, tongs, a grater, a peeler and a corkscrew.
maison.cuisine.titre: A kitchen you can actually cook in
maison.desc: 70 m² fully renovated: a living room opening onto the garden, fitted kitchen, fibre Wi-Fi, barbecue, two bedrooms, walk-in shower. Facilities, baby equipment and what to know before you book.
maison.e1.p: A heat pump and underfloor heating on the ground floor, with a carbon monoxide detector.
maison.e2.p: Dishwasher, oven, microwave, induction hob, fridge, coffee maker, kettle, toaster, utensils and cutlery.
maison.e3.p: Bed linen and towels provided, washing machine, iron and ironing board.
maison.e4.p: Free fibre Wi-Fi. The station is 5 minutes away by car: the house also suits professionals on the move.
maison.e5.p: A terrace on the same level, garden furniture, a barbecue (except during heatwaves), a bike shelter, an enclosed and wooded garden.
maison.e6.p: Free parking alongside the property. The number 7 bus stop is nearby, and the station is 5 minutes away by car.
maison.eq1.p: A large bedroom with a double bed, wide floorboards and an antique wardrobe. It’s also the way through to the bathroom.
maison.eq2.p: A room under the eaves, with a washbasin, an arched window and a roof window (Velux). Two single beds are always made up, and a third is added on request. With the first-floor bedroom, the house sleeps 5, plus 1 baby.
maison.eq3.p: It is on the first floor and you reach it by walking through the bedroom. Walk-in shower, wall-hung WC, washing machine, exposed beam. Bed linen and towels are provided, and so is an iron. A second WC, reached from outside, is next to the bike shelter.
maison.familles.cap: The gate at the top of the stairs
maison.familles.p1: The second-floor room was fitted out for children: a moon-shaped wall light, a glowing heart and coloured lights on the ceiling. Simple things, and children love them.
maison.familles.p3: Baby equipment is available, including a travel cot; a safety gate closes off the top of the stairs. Books and games await the children in their room.
maison.hero.lead: A detached house from the 1920s, 70 m² over three levels, rated three stars. Renovated with craftspeople from the region and low-carbon materials.
maison.savoir.cap: The bathroom door, from the first-floor bedroom
maison.savoir.d1p: As is often the case in old houses, the treads are narrow. For young children, a safety gate closes off the top of the stairs.
maison.savoir.d2t: The bathroom is reached through the first-floor bedroom
maison.savoir.d3p: The bedrooms are spread over two upper floors, there is no lift and the bathroom is on the first floor. Only the living room, the kitchen and the terrace are at ground level.
maison.savoir.d4p: For the shower and the WC, everyone comes down to the first floor.
maison.savoir.d4t: The second-floor room has its own washbasin
maison.savoir.intro: An old house has its quirks.
maison.sdb.titre: A walk-in shower under the beam
maison.vivre.p1: On the ground floor, the sitting area, the dining area and the conservatory are all one space. The glass doors open onto the terrace — you can step out barefoot for your coffee.
maison.vivre.p2: A travertine floor, a pale wood panelled wall and a table that seats 6 to 8. A corner with games, guides and books is available in the dining room.
maison.vivre.titre: One large room and the garden around it
